entries.source: Chat Edit: 'Can you make it so that if any workload command takes longer than 45 minutes, it times out and repots this somehow in the time. Also once the run_all_measurements script finishes, I want it to send me an email with how long it took'
Chat Edit: 'The bash -l is making the LD_PRELOAD bind to bash, and not our application. This prevents us from migarting pages and count PEBS samples properly. Please fix this'
Chat Edit: 'Before running nomad, can you ensure that we are running kernel version 5.13+ and the nomad kernel module is activate which is located in ~/SoarAlto/run/nomad_module'

Chat Edit: 'Nomad needs to have these settings which are set differenly in setups.h

    echo 1 | sudo tee /sys/kernel/mm/numa/demotion_enabled
    echo 2 | sudo tee /proc/sys/kernel/numa_balancing

    Also please look for any other required settings for noma which are in run.sh that i missed'
Chat Edit: 'also be sure to read run.sh to figure out if there is anything else unique we needto add for tpp that is different from nomad. Also remove special things we added for nomad'

Chat Edit: 'Can you make sure that migrations are enabled for the baseline script. We are trying to test the default linux run

IE we need numa_balencing on, we need deomtions and promotiosn set to the default.

Any other settings that got changed from the default that would change the migration behavior needto change'
Chat Edit: 'Can you make the baseline run setup.sh, and then just set the values back to their defaults. It might be useful to print the defualts out now as I have only run the baseline on this boot'
Chat Edit: 'measurement_capture_baseline_default_migration_settings can only be called on startup, and then the values that are collected from that have to be usedf or the entire benchmark'

Chat Edit: 'instead of having custom code to fetch the default values I have collected them for you

just set based off the following command outputs

zimooo2@node0:~/tiering_solutions$ cat /proc/sys/kernel/numa_balancing
1
zimooo2@node0:~/tiering_solutions$ cat /proc/sys/vm/zone_reclaim_mode
0
zimooo2@node0:~/tiering_solutions$ cat 
^C
zimooo2@node0:~/tiering_solutions$ cat /sys/kernel/mm/numa/demotion_enabled
false


Set them how we do in nomad and removed the now unused code '
Chat Edit: 'I meant the other way. Add it to run_all_measurements_train_dram_only'
Chat Edit: 'for measurement dram_only  copy offcore_write_l3_metrics.log into the log folder'
Chat Edit: 'Can you update the model run script to use the new moving average features'

Chat Edit: 'Right now promotion and demotion are scaled by switch_scaler. I would alos like to scale by the WORKLOAD_VIRTUAL_STEP_SAMPLES environment variaible. This is parsed in static uint64_t parse_virtual_step_samples_env(), but will probably need to be parsed differently for this case'
